ns2:section.sectionText: Not intended for students in the Natural Res & Env Sci department. This is an online course taught on Compass with no classroom sessions. However, you must be present for evening exams at 7:00 PM on November 1 and November 15, as well as a final exam to be scheduled. Course is limited to first 500 students who enroll (no waiting list, no course overrides, no exceptions). Further information at: http://go.illinois.edu/NRES102.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for Natural Resrcs & Environ Sci major(s).
